Here's an article in @dodo about the founding of our shelter, the unique aspect of joining homeless people and homeless dogs, and some of the amazing success stories. You can also watch the two beautiful short films produced by Laura Poitras about this: 

thedodo.com/close-to-home/gl…

People often praise this kind of work as selfless. It's not. Each dog gives you something of great value.

And while providing a support network for homeless people often fails, the success stories are immensely gratifying.

More about our project here:

gofundme.com/f/homeless-peop…

One key realization when you work with dog rescue and adoption that deserves far more attention: the best option for many if not most people wanting to adopt a dog is to adopt older dogs from a shelter!

Many people are not equipped to raise puppies. They are very hard work, especially for older people or those who live alone. Older dogs are calmer, have genuine wisdom, and provide intensely loving and loyal companionship that human beings crave. They know what you've done for them.

Some of the

There's a lot of discourse now about homeless addicts on the streets with dogs. It's of course true those dogs are often neglected or worse (though abandoned dogs who have nobody also suffer horrible fates as bad if not worse).

But many homeless people are uniquely, genuinely devoted to their dogs. Academic studies show the unique bond between homeless people and their dogs. Our shelter was inspired by an encampment of homeless people we stumbled into near our house, and their life mission -- w

In 2017, we created a shelter -- @abrigo_hope -- for homeless dogs.

The idea was to hire homeless people on the street with their dogs, then help them us their income to leave the street permanently.

We're super excited about our newly built shelter that doubles our capacity:

Many killed on Oct 7 in Israel were not civilians at all. The death toll included well over 300 active-duty soldiers: legitimate military targets, including from Hamas attacks on military bases. The number of civilians killed is closer to 700.
